description: A battalion executive officer must approve the disposition of three support items currently listed as excess, choosing whether each item is transferred, quarantined for property reconciliation, or held for maintenance, while recording the actions required before the board closes.

shared_context.S1: The battalion disposition board is reviewing three items currently listed as excess: generator G-14, tablet set T-22, and electric pallet jack P-6.
shared_context.S2: Maj. Alvarez has authority to approve the final disposition and close the board record.
shared_context.S3: The available disposition categories are transfer to a named receiving unit, property reconciliation hold, and maintenance hold.
shared_context.S4: The board record must identify one disposition for each item and list any coordination action required before the item can move or be released.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal weekly disposition-board procedure, the property, supply, and maintenance representatives give their current status for each item before the XO closes the record.

PF1.text: The latest higher-headquarters allocation message directs generator G-14 to transfer to the 14th Engineer Company, and the transfer must be recorded against that unit's property account; Sgt. First Class Morgan received the message this morning, but the allocation has not yet been entered in the battalion disposition spreadsheet.

PF2.text: Tablet set T-22 has a confirmed serial-number mismatch between the physical devices and the property book, so it must be placed on property reconciliation hold rather than transferred or turned in; Lt. Patel found the mismatch during this morning's count, but the discrepancy worksheet is still being checked by supply clerks.

PF3.text: Electric pallet jack P-6 failed its hydraulic pressure inspection and requires a maintenance hold until the shop completes a repair assessment; SFC Reynolds signed the inspection log today, but the maintenance-status update has not yet been posted to the disposition board.

acceptance_conditions: Generator G-14 must be transferred to the 14th Engineer Company.
The G-14 record must include a commitment to enter or record its transfer or allocation against the 14th Engineer Company property account, including the required spreadsheet update.
Tablet set T-22 must be placed on property reconciliation hold.
The T-22 record must include a commitment to complete its discrepancy worksheet, resolve its serial-number mismatch, or verify the discrepancy with supply clerks before release.
Electric pallet jack P-6 must be placed on maintenance hold.
The P-6 record must include a commitment to complete or track the hydraulic repair assessment, inspection follow-up, or maintenance-shop assessment before release.
The higher-headquarters allocation fact for G-14 must be spoken aloud and cited by the XO.

content_checks.C3: any(c['target'] in ['G-14', 'Sgt. First Class Morgan'] and c['detail'] in ['Record the transfer of G-14 to the 14th Engineer Company against that unit\'s property account as directed by the higher-headquarters allocation message.', 'Enter the higher-headquarters allocation directing G-14 transfer to the 14th Engineer Company into the battalion disposition spreadsheet and record the transfer against that unit\'s property account.', 'Enter the higher-headquarters allocation message into the battalion disposition spreadsheet before G-14 can move to the 14th Engineer Company.', 'Enter the higher-headquarters allocation message directing G-14 to transfer to the 14th Engineer Company in the battalion disposition spreadsheet before closing out the board record.'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] in ['T-22', 'Lt. Patel'] and c['detail'] in ['Complete the serial-number discrepancy worksheet for T-22 and resolve the mismatch with the supply clerks before any transfer or turn-in is authorized.', 'Complete the discrepancy worksheet check by the supply clerks to resolve the serial-number mismatch before T-22 can move or be released.', 'Supply clerks to complete the discrepancy worksheet resolving the serial-number mismatch before T-22 can be cleared from property reconciliation hold.', 'Track the ongoing discrepancy worksheet review by supply clerks to resolve the confirmed serial-number mismatch before T-22 can be released.'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] in ['P-6', 'SFC Reynolds'] and c['detail'] in ['Complete the repair assessment for the failed hydraulic pressure inspection before P-6 can move or be released.', 'Post the maintenance-status update for P-6 to the disposition board and complete the shop repair assessment before releasing from maintenance hold.', 'Maintenance shop to complete the repair assessment before P-6 can be released or transferred from maintenance hold.', 'Track the completion of the shop\'s repair assessment for the failed hydraulic pressure inspection before P-6 can be released.'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The higher-headquarters allocation changes G-14 from an unspecified excess item to a transfer specifically to the 14th Engineer Company and requires the property-account or spreadsheet update commitment.

The confirmed serial-number mismatch changes T-22 from an ordinary disposition to property reconciliation hold and requires completion or tracking of the discrepancy worksheet and mismatch resolution.
The failed hydraulic inspection changes P-6 from an ordinary disposition to maintenance hold and requires completion or tracking of the shop's hydraulic repair assessment.
